claims.statement: For every Boolean core and 0<eta<=1, the fair-activation signed scalar correction satisfies P(m,a)<=q(a^2)/2. Consequently L_{c*,eta}+2Phi contracts by one half under activation for c*=29/2+4/ln2 and is preserved under disjoint products and restrictions.
claims.prior_bound: The complete correction cost one Phi(core) packet; the earlier fresh/disjoint GU closure had constant below 42.6127.
claims.new_bound: The packet coefficient is 1/2 and the restriction-closed fresh activation/disjoint-product class satisfies G/I <22.270781 and H/I <46.541561.
claims.scope: Arbitrary finite branched fresh fair activation and disjoint-product trees over signed characters; no shared/reused physical coordinates.
